description: 1v1: two greedy bots, hard dropping 24 and 27 frames after each piece comes in, play in lockstep, with the test harness in the server's part: each engine cancels each attack against its own garbage meter at the lock that makes it, and the harness sends what is left on to the opponent, recorded in their log as garbageReceived at the next frame. 66 attacks, 10 of them cancelled, 2 only in part, so 58 received, and 26 and 21 garbage landings, recorded as garbageAccepted. From frame 7,200 margin time multiplies attacks and carries the fraction of a line: at frame 8,122 player 1's 1-line attack, ×1.25 plus the 3 quarter-lines carried from frame 8,091, sends 2 lines. Player 0 tops out at frame 10,239, where the replay ends.
